scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', '.nyc_output', 'coverage'].forEach(d => fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.check-all: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.skills:validate: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); try { JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('skills/index.json', 'utf8')); console.log('✅ skills/index.json is valid JSON') } catch (e) { console.error('❌ Invalid skills/index.json:', e.message); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.config:validate: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); try { JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('opencode.json', 'utf8')); console.log('✅ opencode.json is valid JSON') } catch (e) { console.error('❌ Invalid opencode.json:', e.message); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.mcp:validate: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('opencode.json', 'utf8')); const mcpPath = path.join(config.project?.root || '.', 'opencode.json'); try { JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(mcpPath, 'utf8')); console.log('✅ MCP config is valid') } catch (e) { console.error('❌ Invalid MCP config:', e.message); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.autoresearch:test: echo 'Running autoresearch dry run...' && node -e "console.log('✅ /autoresearch feature ready (use /autoresearch in OpenCode CLI)')"
